name: The Citizens Foundation USA
mission:
The Citizens Foundation, USA (TCF-USA) is a professionally managed tax-exempt charity, with a support network of volunteer chapters across the USA. We support the building of civil society in Pakistan by providing quality education to underprivileged children, promoting gender equality & partnering for reform of public education. We believe that education is a basic human right. Universal access to education is a prerequisite for democratic institutions to flourish in Pakistan and for its people to compete in a global economy.
TCF currently has 1,833 schools in all the provinces of Pakistan with 280,000 children enrolled, nearly half of them girls. TCF has trained and employed 13,000 women as teachers and principals, making it the largest employer of women in the private sector.
TCF also provides scholarships for tertiary education to the deserving graduates of its' secondary schools and an adult literacy program that has transformed the lives of women.
theoryOfChange: The Citizens Foundation USA (TCF-USA) outlines its strategy for mitigating the education crisis post-COVID-19, built around three primary objectives: Retaining TCF students, Expanding Access, and Re-enrolling private school dropouts. This document details how TCF-USA aims to achieve its mission through these strategic objectives.

In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="3">$21,703,144 in total revenue</cite>, directing an exceptional program expense ratio of <cite id="3">88.4% directly to program expenses</cite>. The charity maintains <cite id="1">a 99.3/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>, backed by a perfect score in culture and leadership and strong financial accountability. TCF USA delivers direct education through programs including TCF Schools, adult literacy, and government school management. With a verified low cost per beneficiary and rigorous operational tracking, the charity offers a highly effective channel for donors seeking high-impact international education solutions.
